comment: Pinned build dependency. tools/setup.py refuses any download whose SHA-256 differs, so a changed or substituted tarball stops the build instead of silently altering the ROM it produces.

vasm.why: Motorola syntax, and -no-opt disables the instruction relaxation that makes byte-exact reassembly impossible with GNU as. Verified: move.l #1,d0 stays 203c00000001 under -no-opt, but becomes 7001 (moveq) by default.
